Name: Stardew Day Delay
Author: iamtal
Description:
It's so easy to lose track of time in Stardew, and one day starts to blend into the next. This mod allows you to configure a delay (in seconds) that will be implemented between each day. This will allow you to stay aware of your playtime and provide a nice quality of life change.

The delay is configurable up to 600 seconds (10 minutes) in 10 second intervals. A config.json file will be generated on first launch, and this mod works with Generic Mod Config Menu to set the delay.

Manifest.Name: Stardew Day Delay
Manifest.Description: Adds a configurable delay and exit prompt after the nightly save. Players will be presented with an option to continue to the next day or exit to title at the end of the delay.
Manifest.Author: theonlytal
